question: Will oven-sh/bun publish a GitHub release tagged bun-v1.4.6 or later between Nov 28 and Dec 11, 2026 (UTC)?
resolutionCriteria:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the oven-sh/bun GitHub repository publishes at least one release with a tag that is exactly "bun-v1.4.6" or follows a later semantic version (e.g., bun-v1.4.7, bun-v1.5.0, bun-v2.0.0, etc.) strictly after 2026-11-28T00:00:00Z and at or before 2026-12-11T00:00:00Z.
- "No": Wins if no such release tag meeting the above condition exists in the oven-sh/bun GitHub repository strictly after 2026-11-28T00:00:00Z and at or before 2026-12-11T00:00:00Z.

Clarifications:
- A qualifying tag is any tag of the form "bun-vX.Y.Z" where the version X.Y.Z is semantically greater than or equal to 1.4.6 (i.e., bun-v1.4.6 itself, or any higher patch, minor, or major version).
- The release's publication timestamp on GitHub (the "published_at" field) must fall strictly after 2026-11-28T00:00:00Z and at or before 2026-12-11T00:00:00Z to count.
fact: The oven-sh/bun GitHub releases API shows the highest tag as bun-v1.4.5 (published 2026-11-19T08:47:28Z), read at 2026-11-26T15:20:04.865Z. Against the market's minimum bun-v1.4.6 and window opening 2026-11-28T00:00Z: version qualifies=false, published after window=false. Across 9 recent releases the median gap is 18.8 days; 7.3 days had elapsed since 2026-11-19T08:47:28Z at read time, putting the next release around 2026-12-08 on that cadence.
relevance: Resolution uses the release tag and published_at field from this repository within 2026-11-28T00:00Z to 2026-12-11T00:00Z. This is the authoritative machine-readable record; the cadence arithmetic is derived from its own release history.
working: Compared 30 tags by semantic version; highest = bun-v1.4.5 = 1.4.5; minimum qualifying = 1.4.6; comparison result = < minimum; published_at 2026-11-19T08:47:28Z vs window start 2026-11-28T00:00Z = before. Cadence: median of 8 gaps = 18.8 days; days since last = 7.3; overdue = -11.5.
